notes: Operator-maintained ticker→CIK map for the SEC adapter. The CIK is the identity key used in the request URL and is re-checked against the response. expected_entity_name_contains is an additional normalized containment check on the response entityName; a mismatch is a hard failure, not a warning. Extend this file to collect further US issuers; no code change is required. 2330.TW maps to Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (CIK 0001046179), the SEC filer (Form 20-F/6-K) and issuer of the TWSE 2330 common shares; its 6-K headers state "TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM". The row is used only to bind archive document URLs to that issuer; the latest-financials check for TWSE/TPEx tickers follows the Taiwan statutory deadline, not the SEC 10-Q/10-K index. The 2330.TW name check is "TSMC" because TSMC exhibits (e.g. earnings releases) name the issuer only as "TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM)"; the archive-path CIK remains the identity key.
